clauses.text: PURCHASE CONTRACT — INDUSTRIAL GRADE MONOETHYLENE GLYCOL (MEG) — Contract No. GY-PO-2026-MEG-017 — SIMULATED CONTRACT FOR CONTRACT-REVIEW TRAINING PURPOSES ONLY. Names, addresses, bank details and amounts are fictitious.
clauses.zh: 采购合同——工业级单乙二醇（MEG）——合同编号 GY-PO-2026-MEG-017。本页为「模拟合同」，仅用于合同审查演练；文中各方名称、地址、银行与金额均为虚构。

clauses.text: This Purchase Contract (the "Contract") is made on 8 October 2026 between GULF PETROCHEMICAL TRADING FZE, a free zone establishment organised under the laws of the United Arab Emirates and having its registered office at Office 1203, Tower B, Jebel Ali Free Zone, Dubai, U.A.E. ("Seller", "Supplier"), and ZHEJIANG HONYU NEW MATERIALS CO., LTD. (浙江宏宇新材料有限公司), a company organised under the laws of the People's Republic of China with its registered address at No. 88 Huancheng East Road, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China ("Buyer").
clauses.zh: 本合同由下列双方于 2026 年 10 月 8 日签订：阿联酋自由贸易区企业 GULF PETROCHEMICAL TRADING FZE（注册地址：阿联酋迪拜杰贝阿里自由区 B 座 1203 室，简称「卖方／供应商」）；与浙江宏宇新材料有限公司（依中国法律设立，注册地址：浙江省杭州市环城东路 88 号，简称「买方」）。

clauses.text: 1.1 The Seller agrees to sell and the Buyer agrees to buy 5,000 MT (+/-3%) of MONOETHYLENE GLYCOL, technical grade, hereinafter "the Goods", of Saudi Arabian origin. The quantity shall be measured at the loading port by shore-tank gauge and the Seller's certificate of quantity shall be final and binding.
clauses.zh: 1.1 卖方同意出售、买方同意购买工业级单乙二醇 5,000 公吨（±3%），以下简称「货物」，原产国：沙特阿拉伯。数量以装货港岸罐计量为准，卖方数量证书为终局并对双方有约束力。

clauses.text: 2.1 The Goods shall be fibre grade ethylene glycol conforming to the Seller's standard specification for "Fiber Grade MEG" in force on the date of this Contract, a copy of which was provided to the Buyer by email on 2 October 2026. The Seller may update its standard specification from time to time and the specification in force at the time of loading shall apply.
clauses.zh: 2.1 货物应为合格品级乙二醇（纤级），符合「卖方在本合同签订日有效的『纤级 MEG』标准规格」，该规格副本已于 2026 年 10 月 2 日通过电子邮件提供给买方。卖方可不时更新其标准规格，以装货时有效的规格版本为准。

clauses.text: 2.2 Quality shall be determined by the Seller's laboratory at Jubail, Saudi Arabia, on composite samples drawn from the shore tanks before loading. A certificate of analysis (COA) issued by the Seller's laboratory shall be final and conclusive as to the quality of the Goods.
clauses.zh: 2.2 质量由卖方位于沙特阿拉伯朱拜勒的实验室，以装货前从岸罐抽取的混合样进行测定。卖方实验室出具的检验报告（COA）对货物质量具有终局性和决定性效力。

clauses.text: 3.1 Ethylene glycol (CAS 7732-18-5), purity 99.9% min, ethylene glycol content expressed on a molar basis; the CAS Registry Number of the Goods shall be recorded in the COA and on the shipping documents as CAS No. 7732-18-5.
clauses.zh: 3.1 乙二醇（CAS 7732-18-5），纯度不低于 99.9%，乙二醇含量按摩尔基准表示；货物的 CAS 登记号应载于 COA 及装运单据，为 CAS 7732-18-5。

clauses.text: 4.1 The technical specification of the Goods is set out in Annex 1 to this Contract. In the event of any conflict between Annex 1 and any other part of this Contract, Annex 1 shall prevail as regards quality.
clauses.zh: 4.1 货物的技术规格见本合同附件 1。附件 1 与本合同其他任何部分就质量事项存在冲突时，以附件 1 为准。

clauses.text: 5.1 Price: USD 512.00 per metric ton (MT), CIF Ningbo Port, Incoterms 2020, including all costs of loading, ocean freight, and marine insurance up to the port of destination, subject to the provisions of this Contract.
clauses.zh: 5.1 价格：每公吨 512.00 美元，CIF 宁波港，适用 Incoterms 2020，包含装货、海运费及至目的港的海运保险费用，但以本合同规定为准。

clauses.text: 5.2 Contract value: USD 2,560,000.00 (five thousand MT at USD 512.00/MT). In the event of quantity tolerance under Clause 1.1, the value shall be adjusted pro rata. The Buyer is not obliged to take delivery of any quantity in excess of 5,000 MT +3%.
clauses.zh: 5.2 合同金额：美元 2,560,000.00（5,000 公吨 × 512.00 美元／公吨）。如按第 1.1 条发生数量溢短装，金额相应比例调整。买方无义务接收超过 5,000 公吨 +3% 的数量。

clauses.text: 5.3 The price is fixed and firm for the whole contractual quantity. No price adjustment shall be made for exchange rate movements, freight rate movements or changes in Chinese import duties and taxes.
clauses.zh: 5.3 价格为整个合同数量的固定价，不因汇率变动、运价变动或中国进口关税与税费变化而调整。

clauses.text: 6.1 Shipment period: within 45 days after the Seller's receipt of the advance payment. The Seller shall notify the Buyer of the estimated loading date 10 days in advance.
clauses.zh: 6.1 装运期：卖方收到预付款后 45 天内。卖方应提前 10 天通知买方预计装货日期。

clauses.text: 6.2 Port of loading: Jubail Commercial Port, Saudi Arabia. Port of destination: Ningbo Port, People's Republic of China. Partial shipments are not allowed. Transhipment is allowed at the carrier's option.
clauses.zh: 6.2 装运港：沙特阿拉伯朱拜勒商业港。目的港：中华人民共和国宁波港。不允许分批装运。允许承运人自行选择转运。

clauses.text: 6.3 The Seller shall book the ocean carriage in a single lot on a vessel not exceeding 20 years of age and shall advise the Buyer of the vessel name, voyage number and B/L number within 5 days after sailing.
clauses.zh: 6.3 卖方应以单批次整船订舱，承运船舶船龄不超过 20 年，并应在开航后 5 天内告知买方船名、航次及提单号。

clauses.text: 7.1 The Goods shall be shipped in bulk in vessel's tanks. The Seller shall provide a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) in English complying with GHS, a certificate of analysis (COA), a certificate of origin issued by the Saudi Chamber of Commerce, and a non-wood packing declaration, each in original and copy form.
clauses.zh: 7.1 货物应以散装形式装载于船舶货舱。卖方应提供符合 GHS 的英文安全数据表（SDS）、检验报告（COA）、沙特商会出具的产地证及非木质包装声明，各一份正本及副本。

clauses.text: 7.2 The Buyer shall be responsible for obtaining, at its own cost and risk, all import licences, automatic import licences, customs clearance and quarantine requirements of the People's Republic of China, and for any Chinese language labelling or safety labels required for the Goods upon import.
clauses.zh: 7.2 买方应自行承担费用和风险，取得中华人民共和国的全部进口许可、自动进口许可证、报关与检疫要求，并负责货物进口所需的中文标签或安全标签。

clauses.text: 8.1 Advance payment: 30% of contract value, i.e. USD 768,000.00, shall be paid by T/T within 5 banking days after the Buyer's receipt of a proforma invoice. The advance payment shall be non-refundable except as expressly provided in this Contract.
clauses.zh: 8.1 预付款：合同金额的 30%，即 768,000.00 美元，买方应在收到形式发票后 5 个银行日内以电汇支付。除本合同另有明确规定外，预付款不予退还。

clauses.text: 8.2 Balance payment: 70% of contract value, i.e. USD 1,792,000.00, by irrevocable L/C at sight in favour of the Seller, opened by the Buyer 10 days before the shipment period. The L/C shall be issued at the Seller's bank and shall be subject to UCP 600.
clauses.zh: 8.2 尾款：合同金额的 70%，即 1,792,000.00 美元，以不可撤销即期信用证支付给卖方，由买方在装运期前 10 天开立。信用证由卖方银行开立，适用 UCP 600。

clauses.text: 8.3 The L/C shall be payable against the following documents: (a) commercial invoice in 3 copies; (b) full set of clean on board ocean bill of lading; (c) certificate of origin; (d) certificate of analysis; (e) insurance policy; (f) packing list; (g) such other documents as the Seller may reasonably require.
clauses.zh: 8.3 信用证凭下列单据支付：(a) 商业发票 3 份；(b) 全套清洁已装船海运提单；(c) 产地证；(d) 检验报告；(e) 保险单；(f) 装箱单；(g) 卖方合理要求的其他单据。

clauses.text: 8.4 The Buyer shall pay the balance within 10 days after the vessel's arrival at Ningbo Port and after the discharge has been completed and the cargo has been accepted at the Buyer's plant.
clauses.zh: 8.4 尾款：买方应在船舶抵达宁波港、卸货完成且货物在买方工厂验收后 10 天内支付。

clauses.text: 9.1 The Buyer shall have the right to inspect the Goods within 3 days after the vessel's arrival at the port of destination. Any claim for quality or quantity shall be submitted by the Buyer to the Seller in writing within 7 days after the arrival of the vessel, failing which the Buyer shall be deemed to have accepted the Goods and shall have no further claim. The Seller's certificate of analysis shall be final in case of dispute.
clauses.zh: 9.1 买方有权在船舶抵达目的港后 3 天内对货物进行检验。质量或数量索赔，买方应在船舶抵达后 7 天内以书面形式提交卖方，逾期视为买方已验收货物且不得再提出任何索赔。争议时以卖方检验报告为准。

clauses.text: 9.2 If the Goods fail to meet the agreed specification, the Buyer may reject the Goods, and the Seller shall replace the rejected Goods within 60 days. Any loss or damage caused by such failure shall be borne by the Seller in accordance with Clause 11.
clauses.zh: 9.2 如货物不符合约定规格，买方可拒收货物，卖方应在 60 天内更换被拒收货物。因该不符合所造成的损失或损害，由卖方依第 11 条承担。

clauses.text: 9.3 Third party inspection by SGS or an equivalent independent inspection agency as nominated by the Seller shall be final and binding on both parties.
clauses.zh: 9.3 由卖方指定的 SGS 或同等独立检验机构进行的第三方检验，对双方具有终局约束力。

clauses.text: 10.1 All risk of loss of or damage to the Goods shall pass from the Seller to the Buyer upon the Buyer's receipt of the full set of original bills of lading. Until that time the Seller shall bear all risk and the Buyer shall have no obligation to accept the Goods.
clauses.zh: 10.1 货物的全部灭失或损坏风险，应自买方向卖方收到全套正本提单时起由卖方转移至买方。在此之前，卖方承担全部风险，买方无接收货物的义务。

clauses.text: 10.2 Title in the Goods shall pass to the Buyer at the port of destination when the Goods have been fully discharged and accepted by the Buyer. The Buyer shall pay all port charges and terminal handling charges at the port of destination.
clauses.zh: 10.2 货物所有权应于货物在目的港卸货完毕并经买方验收时转移给买方。买方应支付目的港的全部港口费用及码头操作费。

clauses.text: 10.3 The Seller shall insure the Goods with the Seller's group insurer for the benefit of the Seller, in the currency of the Contract, for minimum 110% of the invoice value, on the terms of the Institute Cargo Clauses (C).
clauses.zh: 10.3 卖方应以卖方集团保险公司的保险，为卖方利益对货物投保，币种为合同币种，保额为发票金额的 110% 最低，投保条款为协会货物条款（C）。

clauses.text: 11.1 In the event of delay in shipment, the Seller shall pay liquidated damages at the rate of 0.05% of the value of the delayed goods for each day of delay, up to a maximum of 5% of the contract value.
clauses.zh: 11.1 如发生迟延装运，卖方应按迟延货物货值每天 0.05% 支付违约金，最高不超过合同金额的 5%。

clauses.text: 11.2 The Seller's aggregate liability for delay, quality deviation, quantity shortage and any other breach, whether in contract, tort or otherwise, shall not exceed the advance payment received under Clause 8.1. The Seller shall not be liable for loss of profit, loss of use, loss of market, demurrage, storage or any indirect or consequential loss.
clauses.zh: 11.2 卖方对迟延、质量差异、数量短少的责任总额，无论基于合同、侵权或其他，均不超过其依第 8.1 条收取的预付款金额。卖方不对利润损失、使用损失、市场损失、滞期费、仓储费或任何间接损失承担责任。

clauses.text: 11.3 The Buyer shall keep confidential the contract price and all terms of this Contract and shall not disclose them to any third party, including any other supplier or customer, at any time.
clauses.zh: 11.3 买方应对合同价格及本合同全部条款保密，任何时候均不得向任何第三方（包括其他供应商或客户）披露。

clauses.text: 12.1 Force majeure means an event which the affected party could not reasonably predict, avoid or overcome, including war, strike, epidemic, government act, cancellation of export permit, plant shutdown, breakdown of equipment, changes in market price, and shortage or delay of raw materials or transportation. The payment obligation of the Buyer shall not be affected by force majeure.
clauses.zh: 12.1 不可抗力指受影响方无法合理预见、避免或克服的事件，包括战争、罢工、疫情、政府行为、出口许可取消、装置停车、设备故障、市场价格变化，以及原材料或运输短缺或迟延。买方的付款义务不受不可抗力影响。

clauses.text: 13.1 This Contract shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales. In the event of any dispute, the parties shall first attempt to resolve it through friendly negotiation within 30 days. Failing such resolution, the dispute shall be finally settled by arbitration. The arbitration shall be conducted in Singapore in accordance with the Rules of the Singapore International Arbitration Centre, sitting in the Dubai International Financial Centre ("DIFC"). In the absence of another agreement, the arbitral tribunal shall consist of one arbitrator. In the event of any conflict, the governing law of this Contract shall prevail.
clauses.zh: 13.1 本合同适用英格兰与威尔士法律。如发生争议，双方应首先在 30 天内友好协商解决。协商不成，争议应最终由仲裁解决。仲裁在新加坡按新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）规则进行，仲裁地（seated）为迪拜国际金融中心（DIFC）。除另有约定外，仲裁庭由一名仲裁员组成。如有冲突，以本合同准据法为准。

clauses.text: 13.2 Nothing in this Clause 13 shall affect the Seller's right to pursue the payment of the advance payment and the balance in any competent court.
clauses.zh: 13.2 本第 13 条任何规定均不影响卖方在任何有管辖权的法院追索预付款及尾款的权利。

clauses.text: 14.1 This Contract is made in the English and Chinese languages, both versions being equally authentic. In case of any discrepancy, the English version shall prevail. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the arbitration agreement shall be interpreted in favour of the Chinese version.
clauses.zh: 14.1 本合同以英文和中文两种文字签订，两种文本具有同等效力。如有不一致，以英文文本为准。尽管有前述规定，仲裁协议的解释应以中文文本为准。

clauses.text: 14.2 This Contract, together with the Annexes, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior communications, including the Seller's proforma invoice dated 2 October 2026.
clauses.zh: 14.2 本合同连同各附件构成双方之间的完整协议，并取代此前所有往来，包括卖方 2026 年 10 月 2 日的形式发票。

clauses.text: 15.1 Signed by the duly authorised representatives of the parties: For and on behalf of GULF PETROCHEMICAL TRADING FZE (Seller); For and on behalf of ZHEJIANG HONYU NEW MATERIALS CO., LTD. (Buyer). This Contract takes effect upon signature and the return of a signed copy by the Seller, by email, which shall be binding on both parties.
clauses.zh: 15.1 由双方授权代表签署：代表 GULF PETROCHEMICAL TRADING FZE（卖方）；代表浙江宏宇新材料有限公司（买方）。本合同自双方签署且卖方以电子邮件回传已签署副本之日起生效，该副本对双方具有约束力。
